categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies startup argument validation and initialization logic to reject an invalid derived port configuration.
categories.rationale: Fails startup cleanly instead of wrapping port 65535 to 0 when deriving the automatic Tor onion service bind port. As the PR notes, without this check, '-port=65535 wraps to 0, so the node binds 127.0.0.1 to a random port and the automatic onion service points there.'
